theme_and_archetype.description: High-energy gamified platform mixing retro arcade nostalgia with neon cyberpunk futurism. Designed to feel like a high-stakes esports arena or arcade cabinet.

primary_display.usage: Main H1/H2 headings, section titles, high-impact marketing copy. Gives a modern esports/Web3 gaming vibe.

secondary_retro.usage: Timers, HUD overlays, score counters, token balances, and 'terminal/arcade' specific moments.

body.usage: Clean body text, descriptions, functional dashboard data, standard buttons.

retro_futurism_terminal.usage: Bet slips, staking modules, live coding/question HUDs
retro_futurism_terminal.classes: bg-[#05050A] border border-neon-cyan/50 drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,255,255,0.3)] text-neon-cyan font-['VT323'] rounded-none

bento_dashboard_cards.classes: bg-[#12121E] border border-white/5 rounded-xl hover:border-cyber-yellow/40 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: High tension and generous spacing. Use The Control Room grid for dashboards and The Tetris Grid for the marketing landing page.

category_micro_aesthetics.name: Sciences

category_micro_aesthetics.name: Cinéma

category_micro_aesthetics.name: Sport

category_micro_aesthetics.name: Musique
category_micro_aesthetics.visuals: Neon grid sunsets, audio visualizer bars, deep purple and cyan gradients (Restricted use of purple just for this specific synthwave context)

pages_architecture.description: High-impact video-game arena hero showcasing the QuizArena concept. Animated 'Living Texture' marquee with top winners. Quick CTA to enter the Arena.
The 'Control Room'. Live match/odds browsing, active duels, upcoming tournaments. User's quick access to Play Solo.
Selection screen resembling a fighting game character select or arcade level select. 6 distinct cards with micro-aesthetics.
components: Category Cards with hover 3D tilt effects

pages_architecture.description: THE CORE EXPERIENCE. Video game UI. HUD overlay, timer countdown (VT323 font), score bursts. Question is framed inside an animated arena.
Split screen Player VS Player setup. Staking module (Bet Slip) where users set their token wager. Winner takes all.
Multi-player bracket visualization. Prize pool display.
Top players, ranks, and badges. Gamified progress cues.
components: User Rows with avatars and XP bars

pages_architecture.description: Coins balance, transaction history. Secure, transparent look.
User stats, win rate, XP, badges. Gamification center.

buttons.primary: bg-cyber-yellow text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wide hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,215,0,0.6)] transition-all
buttons.secondary: border border-neon-cyan text-neon-cyan hover:bg-neon-cyan/10 font-bold uppercase

motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must scale slightly (scale-105) and emit a drop-shadow glow matching their accent color.
motion.page_transitions: Framer motion staggered fade-ins. Score changes must interpolate (count up/down animation).
motion.feedback: Correct answers trigger a 'level-up' particle burst or green neon flash. Wrong answers trigger a red screen-shake (CSS animation).

icons.style: Stroke-based, consistent sizing (w-5 h-5 for buttons, w-8 h-8 for widgets). Use neon glow filters on active icons.

hero_background.description: Vibrant neon lights create a cyberpunk aesthetic in a bustling urban alleyway at night. Use with heavy dark overlay (bg-black/60) for landing page.

arena_backdrop.description: Futuristic city at night with neon lights. Used as the blurred, moving background behind the Live Quiz Play interface.

arcade_element.description: Illuminated pixel art 'Game Over' sign. Use for end-of-game screens or error states.

retro_tech_element.description: A classic arcade space shooter game displayed. Use as an asset in the dashboard or tutorial sections.

fantasy_category_bg.description: Fantasy landscape painting. Use as the background for the 'Histoire' or 'Fantasy' quiz category cards.

development_instructions.css_setup: Include Google Fonts Unbounded, VT323, and Outfit in index.html. Add custom text-shadow and drop-shadow utilities in tailwind.config.js for the neon glow effects.
